definitions.explanation: The act of separating items into different categories, most commonly used for garbage/recycling sorting.

examples.japanese: ゴミの{分別|ぶんべつ}をする。
{分別|ぶんべつ}ルールは{地域|ちいき}によって{違|ちが}う。
きちんと{分別|ぶんべつ}しないと{回収|かいしゅう}してもらえない。
examples.english: If you don't sort properly, they won't collect it.

notes:
READING NOTE:
This word is read ぶんべつ when referring to sorting/separation.
A different reading, ふんべつ, means "discretion, good sense" - a completely different word.

GARBAGE SORTING IN JAPAN:
Japan has strict garbage sorting rules. Common categories include:
・{可燃|かねん}ゴミ - burnable garbage
・{不燃|ふねん}ゴミ - non-burnable garbage
・{資源|しげん}ゴミ - recyclables
・{粗大|そだい}ゴミ - bulky garbage

COLLOCATIONS:
・ゴミの{分別|ぶんべつ} - garbage sorting
・{分別|ぶんべつ}ルール - sorting rules
・{分別収集|ぶんべつしゅうしゅう} - sorted collection
